description: Verifies the static tensor algebra: closed-form 4x4 metric inversion for Minkowski, Schwarzschild, Kerr and a dense indefinite metric, the outer product, index contractions of rank-two and rank-three tensors, and symmetrization, all without a single dynamic allocation.

checks.label: the Minkowski inverse metric times the metric equals the identity
the Schwarzschild inverse metric times the metric equals the identity
the Kerr inverse metric times the metric equals the identity
the dense indefinite inverse metric times the metric equals the identity
the outer product of two vectors has rank 2
every outer product component equals the product of the vector components
contracting both indices of a rank-two tensor yields a scalar
the full contraction of an outer product equals the dot product
contracting two indices of a rank-three tensor yields a vector
the partial trace of the connection-like tensor matches the hand computed vector
the symmetric part equals the mean of the matrix and its transpose
the antisymmetric part equals half the difference of the matrix and its transpose
no dynamic allocation occurs during tensor algebra
